en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_DETAILED_DISPLAY: Show average/max/min timing on the in-game calibration screen.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_FLOAT_OFFSET: Allow the input offset to use decimals instead of whole milliseconds. Ctrl/Shift give .1/.01ms steps in the pause menu.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_POPUP_ON_DEATH: When you die, offer to update your input offset from this run's average timing.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_SONG_USE_MINIMUM: Fixes calibration values reading smaller than they should once the calibration planet has gone around a full loop.
